mission_3.prediction: After increasing the repulsion strength from 0.70 to 1.30 and the influence distance from 1.00 m to 1.50 m while keeping the refinement step at 0.08 m I noticed that the path changed slightly near the person especially on the constrained map. However, the new path was only partially generated and did not completely avoid the person. So increasing the repulsion strength and influence distance can change the robot's path but it does not always successfully find a new route.
mission_3.comparison: For A* social_1 had the highest minimum person clearance of 0.7517 m compared to 0.7359 m in the baseline. Its personal space time also decreased from 1.2 seconds to 0 seconds. However, it took a bit longer and traveled a little farther. For RRTsocial_1 had a minimum person clearance of 1.7431 m compared to 1.7192 m in the baseline. Its personal space time stayed at 0 seconds and it actually took less time and traveled a shorter distance. Overall, social_1 improved the spacing without adding much time or distance. RRT had better results because it kept a greater distance from the person without taking longer or traveling farther.
mission_3.recommendation: I would choose RRT with social_1 because it had a status of succeeded and the highest minimum person clearance of 1.7431 m. It took 43.566 seconds and traveled 11.5056 m. Compared to A* with social_1 which had a clearance of 0.7517 m so RRT kept a much greater distance from the person and also took less time. However, these trials only tested the robot with a person standing still and they don't show how well the robot would react if a person was moving or suddenly walking in front of it.
